notes: Native-green focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 Annex C.2 object-class identity witness. Public Create accepts the same adapter FOM module twice with a queryable class, rejects a separate schema-valid module defining that class with conflicting sharing as InconsistentFOM, and permits valid federation-name reuse. The selected Annex C.2 candidate is mapped directly. FOM and logical-time configuration are adapter-owned. Join-time module composition, other class fields, Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
